Prevention: Choose an appropriate plant date, avoid planting during end of
Monitoring: Take action when high populations of adult black beetles are found in light traps
Direct Control: Use black light light trap for attracting adult black beetles and keep them away (kill them) during early wet season
Restrictions: RD recommendation of insecticide dose, method and crop stages
Use only once time especially, in rice dried out area and optimal humidity in rice field lamda-cyhalothrin
